*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

**Close Kin (Ex):** At 1st level, a moment bringer’s studied target bonuses and the DCs of his slayer abilities increase by 1 against creatures of the same creature type as the moment bringer (and subtype, if the moment bringer is an outsider or a humanoid), but decrease by 1 against other targets.

This ability alters studied target.

**Sudden End (Sp):** At 6th level, a moment bringer can use death knell as a spell-like ability at a caster level equal to his slayer level. This ability can be used only against a creature dealt sneak attack damage by the moment bringer within the previous round. The saving throw against this effect is 10 + 1/2 the moment bringer’s class level + his Intelligence modifier.

This ability replaces the slayer talent received at 6th level.

**Assassinate (Ex):** At 10th level, a moment bringer must select the assassinate advanced slayer talent.

This ability alters the advanced slayer talent received at 10th level.

**Swift Death (Ex):** At 14th level, once per day, a moment bringer can attempt to assassinate a foe without studying his foe beforehand. He must still succeed at a sneak attack against the target.

At 19th level, he can make two such attacks per day.

This ability replaces quarry and improved quarry.

**Slayer Talents:** The following slayer talents (and rogue talents) complement the moment bringer archetype: bleeding attack, fast stealth, powerful sneakAPG, slowing strike, and surprise attack.

**Advanced Slayer Talents:** The following advanced slayer talents (and advanced rogue talents) complement the moment bringer archetype: deadly sneakAPG, evasionUC, and hunter’s surpriseAPG.
